findings.description: The condition uses all(...) where the docstring says the section is written if at least one argument is documented. This should be any(...).
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one documented and one undocumented argument. all() is False, so the whole "Positional arguments" section is omitted and the documented argument's help disappears. When there are no arguments, all([]) is True, so an empty "Positional arguments" section is emitted with write_dl([]).
